senses.gloss: a wicker or net work in the wine or oil press.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 56b:2">Ab. Zar. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>החזיר ג׳ לגת</he> if he placed the net (once used) back into the vat.
<cite ref="Chagigah 22b">Ḥag. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>גורג׳</he> some ed.; <cite ref="Tosefta Chagigah 3:4">Tosef. ib. III, 4</cite>.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:3">Lev. R. s. 22</cite> he gathered the vessels of the Temple <he>ונתנן לתוך ג׳</he> and placed them in a net; <cite ref="Gittin 56b:11">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> he took the curtain <he>ועשאו כמין ג׳</he> and shaped it like &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 6:5">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VI, 5</cite>.

senses.gloss: (from its shrivelled surface) the scarry and lifeless surface of a healed up wound, eschar.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 85a:19">B. Kam. 85ᵃ</cite> <he>העלתה מכתו ג׳</he> if, through neglect of medical advice, the wound became scabby; Y. ib. 6ᵇ bot. [read:] <he>עלתה בו ג׳</he>.
